text: {"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "Fixed strncasecmp() in lib/string.c, which decremented s1 (`*s1--`) instead of incrementing it, so the comparison walked backwards through the first string."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strcspn() iterated with `--p` instead of `++p`, so it walked backwards; I changed it to `++p`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_get_size(), the loop that reduces a size of 32 bits or more decremented the unit index (`i--`) instead of incrementing it, so large sizes got the wrong unit suffix; I changed it to `i++`."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_escape_mem(), `*src--` walked the source pointer backwards; changed it to `*src++` so the input is read forward."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_unescape(), the escape-sequence check used `src[1] == '\\0'` where it should be `src[1] != '\\0'`. I flipped it back, so backslash escapes are processed again. I couldn't build or run the tests in this session."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_option(), a leading '-' was handled with `--cur` instead of `++cur`, so the parser re-read the character before the sign. I changed it to `++cur`. I haven't built it or run the tests."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_options(), the loop-exit check was inverted (`res != 1`), so parsing stopped after any value followed by a comma. It now reads `res == 1`, so parsing stops only when no comma follows."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "Fixed memparse() in lib/cmdline.c, where the 'G' case used `ret << 10;` (no effect) instead of `ret <<= 10;`, so gigabyte suffixes were parsed wrongly."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/siphash.c"], "summary": "Fixed the tail-length mask in __siphash_aligned from `sizeof(u64) - 2` to `sizeof(u64) - 1`, so the trailing 1–7 bytes are counted correctly."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/siphash.c"], "summary": "In __hsiphash_aligned (64-bit), the tail-length mask was `sizeof(u64) - 2` instead of `sizeof(u64) - 1`, so odd tail lengths were computed wrongly. I fixed the mask. I couldn't build or run the tests here."}
